title: Officer signs in and lands on the Dashboard
preconditions: Nobody is signed in on this browser. Use account 900004 (Treasurer). On a fresh seed no password change is asked (docs/MEMBER_TESTING.md section 2).
steps: 1. Open the HIUSA address you were given.
2. Type 900004 in the box "School ID / ID Number".
3. Type the password in the box "Password".
4. Click "Sign in".
5. Read the page and the top bar.
expected: You land on the officer Dashboard (the address ends in /dashboard/officer). The top bar shows your name and your organization with "SBO Officer". The side menu is the officer menu. No password change screen appears.

title: A wrong password is refused with a clear message
preconditions: Signed out. Use a real officer School ID such as 900004. Do this only once or twice: five wrong tries lock the account for 15 minutes and other testers may share it (docs/MEMBER_TESTING.md section 8).
steps: 1. Type 900004 in "School ID / ID Number".
2. Type a wrong password in "Password".
3. Click "Sign in".
4. Read the red message under the boxes.
5. Now type the correct password and click "Sign in" again.
expected: The message reads: "That school ID and password did not match. Check both and try again, or reset your password." You stay on the sign-in page and nothing about the account is revealed. The correct password then signs you in.

title: Signing in with empty boxes does not sign you in
preconditions: Signed out, on the sign-in page.
steps: 1. Leave both boxes empty and click "Sign in".
2. Type only 900004 in "School ID / ID Number" and click "Sign in".
3. Clear it, type only a password and click "Sign in".
4. Read the message each time.
expected: You are never signed in. A red message appears each time and you stay on the sign-in page. VERIFY: the wording. The page may say "Enter your school ID and password to continue." or repeat a field message from the server.

title: The officer menu has exactly the pages an officer may use
preconditions: Signed in as an SBO Officer of PSITS-CCS (900004 Treasurer, 900005 Auditor, 900006 Public Information Officer or 900007 Business Manager). Use the password the demo owner gave you. Use a laptop screen so the full side menu shows.
steps: 1. Sign in as 900004 and look at the left menu from top to bottom.
2. Write down every group and page name you see.
3. Click each group name once and note which page opens first.
4. Look at the bottom of the menu and click "Study objectives".
5. Click "Profile" at the bottom of the menu.
expected: The menu shows: Dashboard. Events and tasks (Check-in, Calendar, Venue booking, My tasks, AI delegation). Finance (view only) (Budgets, Ledger, Financial reports, Forecast). Members and fingerprints. Voting (Candidates, Voters, Results). Store (Orders, Claim desk). Updates (Announcements, Feed). Clearance signing. My activity (Vote, Shop, My orders, My receipts, Statement of account). Small headings Manage, Community, Records and Me sit above the groups. A group opens its first page (Events and tasks opens Check-in, Finance (view only) opens Budgets, Voting opens Candidates, Store opens Orders, Updates opens Announcements, My activity opens Vote). Profile and Study objectives both open. There is no Approvals, People, Officer positions, Events, Planning, Tasks, Inventory, Collections and advances, Student accounts, Compliance, Grievances or Audit log.

title: All four officer positions get the same menu and the same powers
preconditions: Accounts 900004, 900005, 900006 and 900007 are all available. Sign out between accounts. This is a fresh seed (docs/MEMBER_TESTING.md section 2).
steps: 1. Sign in as 900004 (Treasurer) and copy down the side menu.
2. Log out and sign in as 900005 (Auditor). Compare the menu.
3. Log out and sign in as 900006 (Public Information Officer). Compare the menu.
4. Log out and sign in as 900007 (Business Manager). Compare the menu.
5. On each account open Store > Orders and Updates > Announcements and look for buttons.
expected: The menu and the pages are identical for all four. Every position can verify payments, release orders, check people in, update its own tasks and send announcements for approval. The position changes only the title shown under the name (see the Profile case) and which tasks the system suggests for the officer (see the AI delegation cases). No page is hidden or locked because of the position.

title: Each officer position is shown on the Profile page
